privacy.title: Privacy Policy | KLIP
privacy.description: How KLIP collects, uses and protects information from visitors to theklipstudio.com.
heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers theklipstudio.com and explains what we collect, why, and what you can ask us to do about it. KLIP is operated by Klip Studio LLC and Klip Media LLC, 2145 Davie Blvd, Suite 204, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33312.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Information you give us. When you book a room or a session, request a consultation, or submit the Visibility Check form, you provide details such as your name, email address, phone number, business name and the website address you asked us to analyze.
Information collected automatically. Like most websites, our hosting records standard technical data such as IP address, browser type, pages visited and the time of the visit.
We do not ask for, and you should not send us, payment card numbers by email or through this website's forms.

sections.title: How we use it
body: To schedule and deliver what you booked, to answer your enquiry, to send the confirmations and reminders attached to a booking, and to improve the website.

The Visibility Check analyzes the public web address you enter and returns a score based on what is publicly available at that address. If you ask for the results by email, we use your address to send them and to follow up about KLIP services.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Services we use
body: Bookings for studio rooms, photography and tours are handled by SimplyBook.me, which processes your booking details and any deposit under its own terms and privacy policy.
Consultation calls are scheduled through Calendly, under its own terms and privacy policy.
The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. If analytics are enabled, Google Analytics may set cookies to measure how the site is used.
Each of these companies handles the data it receives under its own policy. We recommend reading them if that matters to you.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This site sets no advertising cookies of its own. Embedded booking and scheduling tools, and analytics if enabled, may set their own cookies when you use them. Your browser settings control whether you accept them.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Booking and client records are kept for as long as we need them to run the business and meet tax and legal obligations. Enquiries that do not become work are kept for a reasonable period and then deleted.

sections.title: Your choices
body: You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email info@theklipstudio.com or call 954-541-3708 and tell us what you want done.
You can unsubscribe from marketing email at any time using the link in the message.

sections.title: Photography and footage
body: Work produced for a client belongs to that engagement and is not published by KLIP without permission. If we would like to show your project publicly, we ask first.
Imagery on this site that is not KLIP's own production is licensed stock, used under its license.

sections.title: Children
body: This website is intended for business customers and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from them.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: If this policy changes, the date at the top of the page changes with it. Questions go to info@theklipstudio.com or 954-541-3708.

terms.title: Terms of Service | KLIP
terms.description: The terms that apply to using theklipstudio.com and to booking KLIP Studio and Klip Media services.
heading: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to this website and to work booked through it. Services are provided by Klip Studio LLC and Klip Media LLC, 2145 Davie Blvd, Suite 204, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33312.

sections.title: Using this website
body: You may read and share this site. The text, photography, video, logos and design on it belong to KLIP or to the licensors we obtained them from, and may not be copied for commercial use without permission.

sections.title: Bookings
body: Studio rooms, photography sessions and tours are booked through SimplyBook.me, and that booking is subject to the rate, deposit and cancellation terms shown at the time of booking.
A booking is confirmed when you receive the confirmation from the booking system, not when a request is submitted.
Please arrive and finish within the hours you booked. Time beyond that may be charged at the posted rate if the room is available.

sections.title: Cancellations and changes
body: Cancellation and rescheduling terms are the ones shown in the booking system when you book. If something goes wrong on our side and we cannot provide the room or crew you booked, we will reschedule or refund.

sections.title: In the studio
body: Treat the equipment and the space with care. You are responsible for damage caused by you or your guests beyond normal use.
Do not bring anything unlawful into the studio, and follow the building's rules on access, noise and parking.

sections.title: Your content and ours
body: You keep the rights to your own brand, footage and material. You confirm you have the right to use any music, logos or third-party material you bring to a session.
Deliverables are yours for the use agreed in writing. Drafts and project files remain ours unless we agree otherwise.
Work remains a draft until an authorized KLIP representative approves it for release.

sections.title: Marketing services
body: Advertising, SEO and GEO work depends on platforms and algorithms outside our control. We do not guarantee rankings, placements, impressions or revenue, and we do not promise that any particular result will follow.
The Visibility Check is an automated look at a public web address. It is a starting point, not an audit, and it is not advice.

sections.title: Payment
body: Fees, deposits and schedules are the ones quoted or shown at booking. Work may pause on overdue accounts.

sections.title: Limits
body: This website is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, KLIP is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our liability for any claim relating to a booking is limited to the amount paid for it.
Nothing here limits anything that cannot be limited by law.

sections.title: Governing law and contact
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida. Questions go to info@theklipstudio.com or 954-541-3708.
